meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Nike: hides autoplay promo videos, blurs or hides product and campaign images, can hide card text, Shop buttons, carousels and footer
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome on https://www.nike.com/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA. Both landed on the same page (regional redirect to a country home) with the same Next.js markup, so one structure serves both. Product and search pages could not be captured (network dropped), so none of their markup is used.

- **Promo videos**: `[data-qa="video-card"] video` 2 (LIVE).
- **Images**: `[data-qa="image-media-img"]` 96 and `[data-qa="image-wrapper"]` 100 (LIVE).
- **Card text** `[data-qa="card-overlay"]` 36 and `[data-qa="fig-caption"]` 28; **Shop buttons** `[data-qa="cta-container"]` 20; **carousels** `[data-qa="carousel-filmstrip"]` 12; **footer** `footer` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: product detail pages, search results, the cart, the country picker dialog (`#modal-select-your-location` exists but stayed closed), cookie banners (none rendered). Class names such as `_3w5yT...` and `css-vhpoxs` are hashed and not used; selectors rely on Nike's `data-qa` test attributes, which can change in a release. The sign-in link is never hidden.
